prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game character atlas for an ORIGINAL elegant anime fantasy vertical scrolling shooter, six-character project STARBORNE. This sheet is the first three characters, exactly 3 rows and 5 columns, equal cells, wide image 2560x1536. Every row depicts the SAME character consistently. Column 1 is a beautiful frontal waist-up portrait; column 2 rear-view airborne cruise; column 3 rear-view banking left with left shoulder lowered; column 4 rear-view banking right; column 5 rear-view casting both arms slightly outward. Combat views columns 2–5 are full body, seen from above and behind, heads pointing to TOP of image, hair/coats and bent legs trailing toward BOTTOM, flying AWAY from camera, face NEVER visible. Athletic forward flight, elegant rather than standing. Natural adult anime proportions (not chibi).
Row1: adult woman, copper-red wavy shoulder-length hair, ivory and burnished copper flight coat over fitted deep teal tunic, asymmetrical split coat tails, brass compass at waist; warm amber magic. Named Ember, an aerial cartographer, no text.
Row2: adult woman, short icy-blue bob with one long braided strand, midnight-blue fitted jacket, silver shoulder armor, asymmetric knee-length translucent-looking opaque lavender scarf trailing behind, violet lightning gauntlets. Named Lune, sky courier.
Row3: adult woman, dark brown skin, long dark indigo braided ponytail with turquoise beads, white and cyan flowing sea-silk layered flight dress over leggings, pearl crescent earrings, turquoise water magic. Named Nerine, tide chronicler.
Style: beautiful premium hand-painted anime RPG art, sophisticated restrained costume details, clean readable silhouettes, expressive eyes in portraits, polished cel shading. Original designs, no existing franchise characters, no Genshin symbols or costumes, no witch hats, no twin-tail cat ears. NO text, no labels, no gridlines, no shadows on background. Each subject centered with generous margins fully within its equal cell, no touching between characters or cells, full bodies never cropped. Background perfectly flat #00ff00 chroma key, not used in any costume. Transparent cutout asset requested; keep all edges crisp. All rear views aligned at the same head and hip height within each row.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original character atlas for the same game as the reference. Reference image is style and layout reference ONLY; these three new identities must look distinct. Exactly 3 rows and 5 equal columns, wide image, premium hand-painted anime fantasy RPG art. Column1 beautiful frontal waist-up portrait. Columns2–5 full-body airborne BACK VIEWS flying AWAY toward top of image: cruise, bank left, bank right, arms-out casting. Face never visible in back views. Heads at same height, hips aligned across the row, coats and bent legs flowing downward, athletic forward flight. Do not stand upright. Generous padding: every full-body sprite must fit within cell with transparent space separating neighbors. No magic halo or surrounding particles: clean character silhouettes for procedural game effects.
Row1: adult woman named Sol, strawberry-blonde hair in a single thick loose braid, coral pink cropped flight jacket, charcoal highwaisted shorts and ivory fitted leggings, long asymmetric coral-gold scarf, copper bracers, sun-shaped earring, lively sky mechanic. Warm gold/coral palette, original design.
Row2: handsome adult man named Vesper, long white hair in low ponytail, deep navy fitted coat with violet lining, open split tails, silver chest harness, fitted black pants, violet sigil gauntlet. Lightning swordsman, calm elegant sharp face. No existing franchise costumes.
Row3: adult woman named Aster, moss-dark-green long hair in a looped braid, cream capelet over sage green and seafoam travel dress, tall brown leather boots, small wing-shaped brass hair clip, mint ribbons, gentle botanical sky navigator. Seafoam and sage palette.
Background perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma key with no variation, no texture, no cast shadows, not used in costume. Request transparent cutout. No text, letters, grid, border, watermark. Match the reference's rendering quality and layout, not its characters. Keep all heads/boots inside image edges. Back-facing sprites only in columns2–5. Distinctive memorable original identities, not characters from Genshin.
preparation: Native alpha inspected. Connected component separation, alignment, resizing and WebP encoding. Runtime mesh/strip cloth deformation.
